name: Dental Caries – Enamel
description: Caries confined to enamel; usually managed with fluoride or minimal composite.

name: Dental Caries – Dentin
description: Caries extending into dentin; restoration with composite or GIC indicated.

name: Dental Caries – Pulp Involvement
description: Deep caries reaching the pulp; RCT or pulpotomy is indicated.

name: Irreversible Pulpitis
description: Inflamed pulp that cannot recover; root canal treatment required.

name: Reversible Pulpitis
description: Mild pulpal inflammation that may resolve with removal of irritant and protective restoration.

name: Pulp Necrosis
description: Death of the pulp tissue; root canal therapy required.

name: Chronic Apical Abscess
description: Longstanding periapical infection with sinus tract; RCT or extraction indicated.

name: Acute Apical Abscess
description: Painful periapical abscess with swelling and possible sinus tract; emergency drainage and RCT.

name: Chronic Gingivitis
description: Plaque-induced gingival inflammation without bone loss; treatable with oral prophylaxis.

name: Chronic Periodontitis – Mild
description: 1–2 mm clinical attachment loss; scaling and root planing appropriate.

name: Chronic Periodontitis – Moderate
description: 3–4 mm clinical attachment loss; deeper SRP and reassessment required.

name: Chronic Periodontitis – Severe
description: ≥5 mm clinical attachment loss; surgical management may be needed.

name: Crown Fracture – Uncomplicated
description: Fracture of enamel or dentin only, pulp not exposed; restoration with composite.

name: Crown Fracture – Complicated (Pulp Exposed)
description: Fracture exposing pulp; requires direct pulp cap or RCT before restoration.

name: Dentinal Hypersensitivity
description: Short, sharp pain from exposed dentinal tubules; managed with desensitising agents or GIC.

name: Tooth Wear – Attrition
description: Wear from tooth-to-tooth contact; common in bruxism cases.

name: Tooth Wear – Erosion
description: Chemical dissolution of enamel from acids (dietary or GERD); dietary counselling and protection needed.

name: Impacted Third Molar (Wisdom Tooth)
description: Failure of eruption of the third molar; surgical extraction indicated if symptomatic.

name: Pericoronitis
description: Inflammation around the operculum of a partially erupted tooth; irrigation and possible extraction.

name: Missing Tooth / Partial Edentulism
description: One or more missing teeth; bridge, implant, or removable prosthesis considered.

name: Complete Edentulism
description: Total tooth loss in one or both arches; full denture or implant-supported prosthesis.

name: Malocclusion
description: Abnormal alignment of teeth or bite; orthodontic assessment for treatment planning.

name: Bruxism / Parafunctional Habit
description: Grinding or clenching; splint therapy and monitoring recommended.

name: Recurrent Aphthous Ulcer
description: Painful oral ulcers of unclear aetiology; supportive management with topical agents.

name: Oral Candidiasis
description: Fungal infection presenting as white patches; antifungal medication and underlying cause assessment.
